subject: Re: Kickoff: fractal language metrics track
body:
Priya — resourcing.

Staffing: Wei 50%, Rafael 40%, Gustavo 40%, Amara 30%.

Compute: parameter estimation needs LLM forward passes over large document collections — no training, but a lot of inference; I've sized it at 48 A100s best-effort on titan for the March runs.

The scheduling constraint is data access: our five corpus slices come through Corpus, and with the v2 migration freeze on 2026-07-10 we're planning all extraction against v1 now, with a re-validation pass on v2 before that date — Amara has the extraction jobs specced, and Jun Varga's team confirmed the freeze date when we asked last week.

Storage: 2TB for token-level log-likelihood dumps (the estimators need per-token increments, not just aggregate BPB). One ask: the April correlation study needs eval-suite results from Tomas's team — requesting now to avoid the end-of-quarter Evalline crunch.

Daniela
